name: capture-passive
about: P4 passive capture: the game window is on a hidden desktop (occluded: no game-tree window ever on the input desktop) and never focused (foreground sampler), yet its frames are correct. Correct = full v_resolution frame, not blank, and it tracks game state: between a shot before and after spawning a chest at the player's feet, the changed pixels sit at the screen centre (the camera follows the player) far more densely than anywhere else.

steps.name: the frame changed where the chest appeared, and almost nowhere else
steps.why: foliage sway changes scattered single pixels across the frame (diff of run 20261017-144630); erosion (denoise 3) removes them, the chest is a solid blob just below the centred player; the eroded chest blob measured 21 px inside vs 2 outside (run 20261017-144705), so min_px 12
